announcements.text: Ernst & Young LLP, New York, New York, is being awarded a labor-hour contract with a maximum value of $989,996,050 for audit services of the Department of War of Inspector General Audits of the Department of War agency-wide consolidated financial statements fiscal 2027-2031. Work will be performed in Washington, D.C.; and other locations within and outside the continental U.S., with an expected completion date of March 31, 2032. This contract is the result of a competitive acquisition for which one quote was received. The contract includes an audit of the Defense Working Capital Fund that has a 15-month base period plus four individual 15-month option periods. This contract also includes a DOW Agency-Wide audit that has a 30-month base period plus three individual 15-month periods. Total face value of this award action is $388,273,413. Fiscal 2026 working capital funds in the amount of $62,593,591 will be obligated at the time of award; and fiscal 2027 defense-wide operating and maintenance funds in the amount of $325,679,822, will be obligated when funds are available. The Defense Finance and Accounting Service, Contract Services Directorate, Columbus, Ohio, is the contracting activity (HQ042326FE061).

announcements.text: Peerless Technologies, Fairborn, Ohio, has been awarded a not-to-exceed $85,000,000 ceiling indefinite delivery/indefinite quantity contract for Digital System-Level Mission-Driven Integrated Design Methods for Aerospace Systems (VOLARE). This contract provides research to enable a vehicle system design product and thermal management system design methodologies. Work will be performed at Dayton, Ohio, and is expected to be completed by Sept. 10, 2036. This contract was a competitive acquisition and eight offers were received. No funds are obligated on the basic indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract, however, in conjunction with the basic contract, the first task order (FA2391-26-F-B023) is incrementally funded with fiscal 2026 research and development funds in the amount of $75,000. The Air Force Research Laboratory, Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Ohio, is the contracting activity (FA2391-26-D-B016).
